items.title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug

sentences.en: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug.
Hyperdrive support for MySQL is now generally available (GA).
Hyperdrive , Cloudflare’s database connection pooler for Workers, initially only supported Postgres.
Since we announced the beta for MySQL protocol support last year, we have been working on making our MySQL handling as reliable as our Postgres support.
We’ve learned some things from building and running a MySQL connection pooler on Cloudflare’s network.
It turns out that the difference between beta and GA is just 20 bug fixes in a trenchcoat.
During the beta, our goal was to validate that real-world customer usage hit our production availability target of 99.99%.
We knew there were gaps in our reliability since we track how often client connections from a Worker end in an error related to Hyperdrive.
In addition, we had feedback from customers in the beta that led to the discovery of a rare and subtle bug in our production environment.
To convey the complexity of this particular bug, we first need to explain how Hyperdrive works.
What is Hyperdrive?
Hyperdrive is a distributed database connection pooler that connects Cloudflare Workers to SQL databases.

sentences.en: GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise.

sentences.en: OUR PIPELINE VS. THE PREVIOUS LLM PIPELINE Smarter secret scanning, at a fraction of the cost 11.5% higher acceptance Owner-weighted alert precision 86% lower median scan execution time Post-push scanning 98% lower serving cost Compact model vs. remote LLM calls JavaScript draws the arrows connecting these cards.
sentences.zh: 我们的管道与之前的LLM管道相比更智能的秘密扫描，成本仅为接受度的一小部分所有者加权警报精度降低86%中位数扫描执行时间推送后扫描服务成本降低98%紧凑型模型与远程LLM相比调用JavaScript绘制连接这些卡的箭头。

sentences.en: OUR PIPELINE VS. THE PREVIOUS LLM PIPELINE Smarter secret scanning, at a fraction of the cost 11.5% higher acceptance Owner-weighted alert precision 86% lower median scan execution time Post-push scanning 98% lower serving cost Compact model vs. remote LLM calls Secret scanning works best when developers are confident in the findings.
sentences.zh: 我们的管道与以前的LLM管道相比更智能的秘密扫描，成本仅为接受度的一小部分所有者加权警报精度降低86%中位数扫描执行时间后推扫描服务成本降低98%紧凑型模型与远程LLM调用当开发人员对调查结果充满信心时，秘密扫描效果最佳。

sentences.en: Catch too little, and real credentials can remain in a repository.
sentences.zh: 捕获太少，真实凭据可能保留在存储库中。

sentences.en: Alert too often, and developers may spend time investigating strings that aren t secrets.
sentences.zh: 警报太频繁，开发人员可能会花时间调查不是秘密的字符串。

sentences.en: Generic secrets make that balance especially difficult.
sentences.zh: 通用秘密使这种平衡变得特别困难。

sentences.en: The same string could be a real credential or a documentation placeholder, so detecting it requires understanding the surrounding code and text.
sentences.zh: 相同的字符串可以是真实的凭据或文档占位符，因此检测它需要了解周围的代码和文本。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we trained a secret classifier specifically for GitHub s product needs: distinguishing real credentials from lookalikes while meeting the speed and efficiency requirements of scanning at scale.
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一挑战，我们专门针对GitHub的产品需求训练了一个秘密分类器：区分真实凭据和类似凭据，同时满足大规模扫描的速度和效率要求。

sentences.en: In our companion post, Secret protection must scale with software , we explained why secret protection must keep pace with AI-accelerated development.
sentences.zh: 在我们的同伴帖子中，秘密保护必须与软件一起扩展，我们解释了为什么秘密保护必须跟上人工智能加速发展的步伐。

sentences.en: Here, we go behind the scenes of the context-aware classifier powering that effort: how we designed, trained, and evaluated it to find more real secrets with less noise.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们将深入了解上下文感知分类器的幕后工作：我们如何设计、训练和评估它，以更少的噪音找到更多真实的秘密。

sentences.en: What we enabled GitHub secret scanning operates at two key moments: Push protection helps prevent secrets from entering a repository by scanning changes before a push is accepted, giving developers an opportunity to address the finding.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个关键时刻启用了GitHub秘密扫描：推送保护通过在接受推送之前扫描更改来帮助防止秘密进入存储库，让开发人员有机会解决发现的问题。

sentences.en: Post-push scanning works after code has been committed, continuously scanning repository content and creating alerts when potential secrets are detected so developers and security teams can investigate and remediate them.
sentences.zh: 提交代码后，推送后扫描工作，持续扫描存储库内容，并在检测到潜在机密时创建警报，以便开发人员和安全团队可以对其进行调查和修复。

items.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases

sentences.en: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases.
Traditional database architecture assumes you have one or two big database clusters per application, usually accompanied by a connection pooling solution.
AI-assisted development and vibe coding platforms turn this model inside out and are driving applications toward many small databases: one per user, application, preview environment, or tenant.
That model fits D1 particularly well.
D1 is Cloudflare's managed, serverless database based on SQLite.
It allows you to create millions of databases and only pay for what you use.
The question becomes: how do you scale the control plane for millions of databases without making every query slower by sending it through centralized bottlenecks?
We made a lot of architectural changes to scale out D1 to support platforms with millions of created databases, hundreds of thousands of which are active at any point.
This post is a behind-the-scenes deep dive into how the D1 control plane works.
Many of the architectural patterns we will describe can be used by anyone building on top of Cloudflare’s Developer Platform.
The post also gives a glimpse into how we build our own control planes.

Growth in numbers There was already a steady growth in D1 usage when we started planning these changes, but we knew we would need to support a much bigger scale once large platforms started building with D1.
